name: onlyoffice
title: ONLYOFFICE Docs
description: ONLYOFFICE Document Server edits Word, Excel and PowerPoint files in the browser, with live co-editing. Made for Nextcloud: install the ONLYOFFICE app there, set the Document Server address to this container's URL and the secret key from the stack .env (ONLYOFFICE_JWT_SECRET). Heavy image (≈2 GB), first start takes a minute.

variables.name: ONLYOFFICE_JWT_SECRET
variables.label: JWT secret
variables.description: Shared with Nextcloud so only it may open documents; leave empty and DCS generates one
